# Polyfill for `Object.setPrototypeOf`

[![NPM Version](https://example.invalid/npm/v/setprototypeof.svg)](https://example.invalid/package/setprototypeof)
[![NPM Downloads](https://example.invalid/npm/dm/setprototypeof.svg)](https://example.invalid/package/setprototypeof)
[![js-standard-style](https://example.invalid/badge/code%20style-standard-brightgreen.svg)](https://example.invalid/standard/standard)

A simple cross platform implementation to set the prototype of an instianted object.  Supports all modern browsers and at least back to IE8.

## Usage:

```
$ npm install --save setprototypeof
```

```javascript
var setPrototypeOf = require('setprototypeof')

var obj = {}
setPrototypeOf(obj, {
  foo: function () {
    return 'bar'
  }
})
obj.foo() // bar
```

TypeScript is also supported:

```typescript
import setPrototypeOf = require('setprototypeof')
```
